selection_rule: Per-family final2048 all33 LPIPS only; minimum exact float mean, tie minimum weight; no numerical tie tolerance and no choice of earlier checkpoint.
delta_sign: raw method minus baseline; LPIPS/tLP100/tOF lower is better, PSNR/SSIM higher is better
interpretation_limits: Validation selection evidence only, not held-out test performance.

No new G2/G3/G4 promotion, significance decision or protocol change.
